description: This file contains unit tests for the ImageAttachmentController class within the Corporate Branding plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It tests image retrieval functionalities for various banner images and handles invalid input cases.

classes.name: ImageAttachmentControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that checks the behavior of the ImageAttachmentController for different image retrieval scenarios, including valid images and invalid input.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data from a fixture before any tests run.

methods.name: testClientLogo
methods.description: Tests retrieval and response headers for the client logo image.

methods.name: testClientBanner
methods.description: Tests retrieval and response headers for the client banner image.

methods.name: testLoginBanner
methods.description: Tests retrieval and response headers for the login banner image.

methods.name: testInvalidImageName
methods.description: Ensures that invalid image name requests result in a 400 response code.
